injection.notes: Set scriptData[0].script to a deliberate SyntaxError. validate-ae-scripts invokes `new Function(script)` (parse-only; HC4 carve-out) and catches the SyntaxError. Run with scope={type:'item', id:'<item-id>'} and expect the AE in the 'Syntax errors' section. Also covers issue='unknown-trigger' (set scriptData[0].trigger to a key not in CONFIG.WFRP4E.scriptTriggers) and issue='schema-drift' (set system.scriptData to an object instead of array — pre-v11 shape).
